allocationProof.nativeValue: The cell already holds Ref<Data>; owner_for/Any row metadata supplies that same Data allocation. No Data or target nominal owner is constructed.
allocationProof.structuralValue: The cell may hold a StructuralRef whose existing shared_owner is the source anonymous allocation. Reuse that owner directly; do not call materialize_row, make_ref<D>, recover-as-D, or shared_object to fabricate a nominal object.

restrictions: No conversion to a writable target from this projection.
No new attachment or shadow cell for existing physical member.
Null/undefined must not be merged; present-only projection does not claim nullable factory parameter support. Unsupported state/domain must remain explicit.
Do not treat wrong-typed present nested members as missing. Missing-property absence may remain absence only when the source member is actually absent.
